text: If the zombie apocalypse starts while you're on a farm,
Because without realizing it, you're already standing inside one of the best survival locations possible.
But only if you don't make one very stupid mistake.
Eli's first instinct is to drive into town and find out what's happening.
That's exactly where everyone else is going.
Instead, Eli has about 30 minutes to prepare before the power grid becomes unreliable.
First, water, because his well uses an electric pump.
And when the power dies, so does the well.
He has a generator, but turning it on creates another problem.
On a quiet farm, an engine can advertise your location from hundreds of meters away.
And Eli isn't the only thing living here.
30 chickens, 12 cattle, one horse, and a dog that barks at
Absolutely everything, which means keeping the farm quiet is going to be almost impossible.
So he locks the gate, brings the animals closer to the farmhouse, and starts counting everything he has.
On paper, he could survive here for weeks.
Someone was already inside the fence.
